Sandbox_Cybertruck_WorldSpawn_tooltip: Cybertrucks can turn up in upscale neighborhoods, professional lots and dealerships.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_SpawnChance_tooltip: Weight against other cars in the same zone. The vanilla SUV is 20. Dealerships use double.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_Craftable_tooltip: Adds the Build Cybertruck recipe (Mechanics 8, Welding 7, Electrical 6).
Sandbox_Cybertruck_BatteryDrain_tooltip: Stacks with the vanilla gas consumption setting.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_ChargeHours_tooltip: Game hours to go from empty to full while plugged in.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_GeneratorFuelPerCharg: Generator fuel per full charge, percent of a tank
Percent of a full generator tank burned to charge the truck from empty to full. 0 makes generator charging free.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_GridCharging_tooltip: While the grid is up, a truck parked next to a powered building can plug in for free.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_ArmorAbsorb: Armor absorbs, percent of each hit
Sandbox_Cybertruck_ArmorAbsorb_tooltip: How much of each hit the stainless body and armored glass shrug off.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_SpawnChargeMin_toolti: Lowest charge a Cybertruck can have when you find it in the world, in percent.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_SpawnChargeMax_toolti: Highest charge a Cybertruck can have when you find it in the world, in percent.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_BuildCharge_tooltip: Charge a freshly built Cybertruck rolls out with, in percent.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_RegenStrength_tooltip: How much charge slowing down gives back, in percent of the default. 0 turns regen off.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_CableReach_tooltip: How far the truck can be from a running generator and still plug in.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_EnginePower_tooltip: Acceleration and pulling power, in percent of the default.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_MotorLoudness_tooltip: How far zombies hear the truck. The vanilla SUV is 100. Stacks with the vanilla zombie attraction setting.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_OffroadGrip_tooltip: Pulling power on grass, dirt and brush. Vanilla cars range from 0.8 to 1.3.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_CabinProtection_toolt: What crashes do to the people inside.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_CabinProtectionValues: Reinforced: light bruising, fractures still possible
Sandbox_Cybertruck_GlassDurability_toolt: How well the glass stands up to weapons and gunfire. Vanilla glass is 2.
Sandbox_Cybertruck_PanelDurability_toolt: How well the doors, hood and vault stand up to weapons. Vanilla panels are 5.
